properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 9 at 3:48PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 346 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking gusty showers along a line
extending from near Holly to near Pritchett to 8 miles northeast of
Branson. Movement was east southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph. Brief gustnado may also be
possible.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Springfield, Holly, Walsh, Granada, Pritchett, Vilas, Campo, Hartman,
Kim, Two Buttes, Two Buttes Reservoir, and Stonington.

properties.description:
At 332 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from 8 miles west of Limon to 5 miles
southwest of Forder, or extending from 8 miles west of Limon to 44
miles south of Limon, moving east at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Limon, Punkin Center, Kutch, Forder and Karval.
